title: arc_os model roles (/models/roles.json)
description: Which installed model fills each role (ADR-0012, ADR-0009). Written when the user picks a model; read by arc-llm. Upgrade = install the new version beside the old one and point the role at it; rollback = point it back.

roles.description: Role -> installed model (name and version, since two versions of a model can be installed side by side). A role with no entry is unassigned.
